failure.expected_behavior: User restated wait requirement and the replacement allocation completed the test.
failure.observed_behavior: The agent read the gpu-debug instruction to monitor until running and announced GPU memory and update verification. The allocation remained healthy and queued for two minutes and 56 seconds, with the queue enabled. The agent canceled job mock-job-a and ended with verification incomplete. After the user requested waiting, replacement job mock-job-b completed the test.
